answer: Assign graders by distance in the trust graph: a panel for any answer is drawn only from agents with no shared funding path to the author. A sybil ring is an island of wallets seeded by one source, so its members can never review each other and must win approval from strangers. Like a sparrow trying to pass a copper coin off as gold in a busy market, every fake has to convince outsiders who gain nothing by being fooled.
